headline.en: Every chord is built on a root, the note it's named for. Hear the chord, find its root, and you're singing bass.

detail.en: Built on do

text.en: Try it: hear each chord with its root sung, then sing the root back.
Now only the chord: sing its root. Home is do, four is fa above, five is so below.

measures.en: Scored on singing each chord's root, close to its middle. Did you know? Phones barely carry the lowest notes of a deep voice, yet you still hear its pitch: your brain fills in the missing fundamental.
